name: Cap nach pork
summary: Lợn cắp nách is the small highland pig, light enough to carry to market under one arm. Sa Pa kitchens cook it many ways.
origin: Northwest highland villages, where the pigs are raised small and free-range.
howToEat: Order it as part of a mẹt, a tray of pork dishes for the table.
where: Cá Hồi Vua on Lê Văn Tám, Anh Dũng on Xuân Viên, and Quý Bếp on Lương Định Của all serve it.
seoTitle: Cap nach pork in Sapa — the small highland pig
seoDescription: Lợn cắp nách, the small free-range highland pig, cooked many ways at Sa Pa restaurants.
